Source contracts: build_binary.sh

build_binary.sh

Shell · Tier B

Forward native distribution builds to the canonical Python builder.

Usage

Run on the target platform with native build tools installed.

Inputs

SMTO_BUILD_PYTHON overrides the checkout .venv or PATH interpreter; all arguments reach the builder.

Side effects

The builder stages runtimes, compiles launchers and writes release files.

Cleanup

exec transfers process ownership and exit status to the Python builder.

@see scripts/native_binary_builder.py
